title: Intrinsic Ext determinant is quotient-linear
statement: The intrinsic Ext determinant isomorphism is linear for the quotient action.

proof.text: Choose a Koszul-regular generating sequence. Use the Ext/dual-homology equivalence and compose it with the homology isomorphism of the existing normalized quasi-isomorphism to the determinant. For any quotient scalar choose a representative c in A. Its multiplication endomorphism on A/I is c times the identity. Mathlib Ext.mk₀_smul, Ext.smul_comp and Ext.mk₀_id_comp identify precomposition with c times the Ext class. A-linearity of the composed equivalence identifies this with the restricted quotient action on the determinant. This proves quotient linearity and uses no intrinsic roof normalization.
